insights.concise_text: Because no good quality dataset existed to train NER, the authors created OurNepali dataset from daily newspaper sentences of 2015-2016 and released it to support future research.

triple.subject: no good quality dataset to train NER
triple.object: creation and release of OurNepali dataset

insights.concise_text: The neural based Nepali NER proposed to avoid hand-crafted features was evaluated on the dataset that we created and on the dataset received from ILPRL lab.

triple.subject: neural based Nepali NER
triple.object: the dataset that we created and the dataset received from ILPRL lab

insights.concise_text: The empirical evaluation with state-of-the-art models reporting relative improvement of upto 10% used CoNLL-2003 evaluation scriptBIBREF25 to calculate entity-wise precision, recall and f1 score.

triple.subject: empirical evaluation with state-of-the-art models
triple.object: CoNLL-2003 evaluation scriptBIBREF25

insights.concise_text: FastText embeddings were chosen for their sub-word representation ability, and the model using fastText_Skip Gram embeddings outperforms all other models on OurNepali dataset.

triple.subject: fastText_Skip Gram embeddings
triple.object: all other models on OurNepali dataset

insights.concise_text: Lemmatizing post-positions boosted the F1 score by almost 10%, supporting the discussion that stemming post-positions can help a lot in improving model performance.

triple.subject: lemmatizing the post-positions
triple.object: the F1 score by almost 10%

insights.concise_text: The one-hot encoded vector of POS tags concatenated with pre-trained word embeddings was generated using a BiLSTM model trained with 95.14% accuracy.

triple.subject: one-hot encoded vector of POS tags
triple.object: BiLSTM model trained with 95.14% accuracy

insights.concise_text: Grapheme-level embeddings are randomly initialized from [0,1] with real values with uniform distribution of dimension 30, and BiLSTM+CNN(grapheme-level) performs on par with BiLSTM+CNN(character-level).

triple.subject: randomly initialized grapheme-level embeddings
triple.object: BiLSTM+CNN(grapheme-level) to performance on par with BiLSTM+CNN(character-level)

insights.concise_text: The dropout of 0.5 applied after LSTM layer was chosen because the F1 score starts falling down after dropout rate = 0.5.

triple.subject: dropout rate = 0.5
triple.object: choice of dropout of 0.5 after LSTM layer

insights.concise_text: The experiments performed on the dataset that we created and on the dataset received from ILPRL lab used IO format for both the dataset, hence the dataset does not contain any B-type annotation.

triple.subject: experiments on the dataset that we created and the dataset received from ILPRL lab
triple.object: IO format without any B-type annotation

insights.concise_text: Because OurNepali dataset volume is almost ten times bigger compared to ILPRL dataset in terms of entities, the authors conclude that more data is needed to get better results.

triple.subject: OurNepali dataset volume
triple.object: conclusion that more data is needed to get better results
